gpu_tip: ~46GB total at 128K context, but it's a sparse MoE model — most of those weights sit idle on any given token. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 3060 Ti) keeps the always-on attention/shared layers at full speed while llama.cpp offloads the inactive experts to ~48GB of DDR5 system RAM, staying close to full-GPU speed.
mac_tip: Needs ~46GB — a 48GB MacBook Pro is close to its limit; a 64GB config (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max) is safer.
